fullDescription: A standalone timeline COMPONENT for a marketing or product page: A vertical spine where each entry reveals on scroll and the spine fills to match. Year, title and a bordered body card per entry, with a dot on the spine. Entries reveal through one IntersectionObserver and the spine fill is computed from how many have revealed, so the fill can never disagree with what is actually on screen. Built in the light shadcn register (ground #FAFAFA, cards #FFFFFF, hairline #E4E4E7, one indigo #4F46E5, Inter throughout) so it drops into an existing design system without a restyle. No images, no libraries and no build step; avatars are drawn from initials. About 5KB, responsive to 390px, and it degrades to something genuinely readable under prefers-reduced-motion rather than freezing.
prompt:
## Resumo
A self-contained timeline component. A vertical spine where each entry reveals on scroll and the spine fills to match. Year, title and a bordered body card per entry, with a dot on the spine. Entries reveal through one IntersectionObserver and the spine fill is computed from how many have revealed, so the fill can never disagree with what is actually on screen. The page contains the component and nothing else, so it can be lifted straight into a section.

## Estilo Visual
Ground #FAFAFA, card #FFFFFF, ink #09090B, muted #71717A, border #E4E4E7, accent #4F46E5. Inter 400 for body, 600 for names and titles, 700 for the heading. Radii 12 to 16px, borders 1px, and a single 0 1px 2px rgba(9,9,11,.04) lift on cards. Draw avatars from initials on a coloured disc rather than loading images, so the component has no asset dependency. Ease everything with cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Component
Year, title and a bordered body card per entry, with a dot on the spine. Entries reveal through one IntersectionObserver and the spine fill is computed from how many have revealed, so the fill can never disagree with what is actually on screen.

### Responsive
Reflow rather than shrink: horizontal rails become vertical rails, multi-column grids drop columns progressively, and nothing is allowed to overflow the viewport at 390px.

### Reduced motion
Under prefers-reduced-motion, remove the motion mechanic entirely and show a plain readable equivalent. A magnifying rail or a rotating ring frozen mid-animation is unusable; a list is not.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
A vertical spine where each entry reveals on scroll and the spine fills to match.

### Componente
Initial-based avatars with no image dependency

### Componente
Reduced-motion fallback that changes the layout, not just the timing
